values.headline: MVP Group mobilizes relief ops across Luzon
values.subheadline: THE MVP Group of Companies said it has launched a coordinated multi-sector response to support Filipinos affected by the recent crisis, providing critical connectivity, rescue operations, clean water and road assistance.

values.headline: Middle-class Filipinos remain vulnerable to poverty—experts
values.subheadline: MIDDLE-INCOME Filipinos are crucial to economic growth and national development, but remain vulnerable to economic shocks at risk of falling into poverty, experts and academics said on Wednesday.

values.headline: German-PH businesses cautiously optimistic amid uncertainties
values.subheadline: GERMAN-PHILIPPINE businesses are cautiously optimistic about their growth prospects in the Philippines over the next 12-18 months, despite grappling with uncertainties and global markets, a survey showed.

values.headline: Filinvest Group gets 4 Stevie awards
values.subheadline: MARKING an milestone 70th anniversary, the Filinvest Group emerged as a winner bagging four Stevie Awards for Great Employers 2023, the only Philippine-based firm to snatch four prestigious honors that spotlight its people-first approach and group-wide HR transformation initiatives.

values.headline: Bans ineffective in eliminating vices, says liquor chain executive
values.subheadline: LONGTIME liquor retailers are reminding policymakers that prohibition doesn’t eliminate vices but only pushes it underground, making it more dangerous, more predatory and harder to control.

values.headline: BSP term deposit yields edge down
values.subheadline: The Philippine Health Insurance Corp. (PhilHealth) recently turned over P76.6 million in claims payment to the Quezon City government as an accredited HIV Treatment Hub. PhilHealth acting president and chief executive Edwin Manalo (from left) leads the ceremonial check turnover on July 23, 2025 to Quezon City Mayor Joy Belmonte (fourth from left), witnessed by Quezon City health officer Dr. Josephine Sabando and PhilHealth NCR vice-president Bernadett Lico and other PhilHealth officers.
